chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Hammad, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'The one who exits from the two Harrams after the rising of the day, before he has offered the Zuhr and Asr prayers, is called from behind him: "May Allah not accompany you!"'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pilgrim who leaves the Haram before praying Zuhr and Asr?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the importance of maintaining prayer discipline during the transition from the sacred precincts of Mecca and Medina, emphasizing that neglecting Zuhr and Asr after leaving the Haram incurs a specific divine rebuke. In Shia jurisprudence, this serves as a reminder for pilgrims to prioritize obligatory prayers even amidst the logistical movements of Hajj, ensuring that the spiritual state of Ihram or the sanctity of the Haram is not compromised by delay.
